message.content: {"items":[{"title":"Social change and development in the GDR (1973-1988)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.3504","justification":"Longitudinal survey of GDR population including family formation, marriage and living conditions; covers late 1970s and 1980s, enabling analysis of family life and marriage in the GDR."},{"title":"Family and fertility survey in the GDR 1988","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.3506","justification":"Dedicated survey on family and fertility behaviour in the GDR in 1988, with rich information on marriage, partnership, childbearing and family life shortly before reunification."},{"title":"Population policy and family planning in the GDR 1984","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.3505","justification":"Focuses on population and family policy, including attitudes and behaviour regarding marriage, family size and timing in mid‑1980s GDR."},{"title":"Life in the GDR 1980","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.3510","justification":"General social survey of GDR residents around 1980; includes modules on household composition, partnership status, marriage and family conditions."},{"title":"Life in the GDR 1986","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.3511","justification":"Follow‑up to earlier GDR life surveys, providing mid‑1980s data on living conditions, partnership, marriage and household structures."},{"title":"Marriage and family in the GDR 1982","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.3520","justification":"Survey focused explicitly on marriage and family relations in the GDR in the early 1980s, including partnership histories and family roles."},{"title":"Family and work in the GDR 1985","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.3521","justification":"Examines the relationship between employment and family life in the GDR, with information on marital status, division of labour, childcare and family arrangements in 1985."},{"title":"Youth and family in the GDR 1983","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.3530","justification":"Youth survey including expectations and behaviour about partnership, marriage and starting a family in the GDR during the early 1980s."},{"title":"Housing and family formation in the GDR 1987","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.3531","justification":"Addresses how housing conditions affect partnership, marriage and family formation decisions in late‑1980s GDR."},{"title":"Divorce, partnership and family in the GDR 1988","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.3532","justification":"Special survey on divorce and partnership dynamics shortly before the end of the GDR, highly relevant to studying marriage stability and family life in the late 1980s."}]}
